title: Midas Staff

{{Scam-prone|alt=Scammers will often switch to a lower value Midas Staff while in trade menus.}} {{Infobox/Weapon |slot = Midas Staff;Midas Staff (fragged) |id = MIDAS_STAFF |rarity = l |damage = +130 |strength = +150 |intelligence = +50 |enchantable = yes |reforgeable = yes |museum = y |museum_xp = 12 |museum_category = combat |dungeon_level_requirement= {{skill|catacombs|25}}
(When converted to [[Dungeon Item]]) }} The '''Midas Staff''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Sword]] that can be obtained from the [[Dark Auction]]. Its ability increases in power as more coins are spent on it by the player, similar to the [[Midas' Sword]], up to {{c|100M|short=yes}}. == Obtaining == === Dark Auction === The '''Midas Staff''' can be obtained from the [[Dark Auction]] only when {{NPCSprite|Scorpius}} is elected as mayor, costing a minimum of {{c|100K|s=yes}} to purchase. It will always appear as the eighth and final item for sale. == Usage == |-|Midas Staff = {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |rarity = legendary |damage = 130 |strength = 150 |intelligence = 50 |item_ability_name = Molten Wave |item_ability_activation = Right Click |item_ability_description = Cast a wave of molten gold in the direction you are facing! Deals up to {{Red|12,000}} damage. |item_ability_mana_cost = 500 |item_ability_cooldown = 1s |item_ability_name2 = Greed |item_ability_description2 = The {{Dark Aqua|ability damage bonus}} of this item is dependent on the price paid for it at the [[Dark Auction|{{Dark Purple|Dark Auction}}]]!
The maximum bonus of this item is {{Dark Aqua|26,000}} if the bid was {{c|100000000}} or higher! }} |-| Midas Staff = {{ItemInfo |name =  Midas Staff |slot = Midas Staff (fragged) |type = Sword |rarity = legendary |damage = 130 |strength = 150 |intelligence = 50 |item_ability_name = Molten Wave |item_ability_activation = Right Click |item_ability_description = Cast a wave of molten gold in the direction you are facing! Deals up to {{Red|6,000 - 40,000}} damage. |item_ability_mana_cost = 500 |item_ability_cooldown = 1s |item_ability_name2 = Greed |item_ability_description2 = The {{Dark Aqua|ability damage bonus}} of this item is dependent on the price paid in the [[Dark Auction|{{Dark Purple|Dark Auction}}]]!
The maximum bonus of this item is {{Dark Aqua|34,000}} if the bid was {{c|500000000}} or higher! }} Its ability casts a wave of gold blocks in front of the player, similar to the [[Tank]] class ability Seismic Wave. All enemies caught within the wave take the full ability damage. The wave has a length of 14 blocks and stops upon impact with walls and carpets. The ability has a 1-second cooldown and costs {{Statname|Mana|500}} to use. Its ability damage is increased as the coins spent on the Midas Staff increases, up to a maximum of 26,000 bonus base damage at {{c|100M|s=yes}}, or 32,000 ability damage in total. A [[Golden Dragon Pet]] also buffs the ability by up to {{Green|10%}}. == Upgrading == The '''Midas Staff''' can be upgraded to the '''{{Fragged}} Midas Staff''' with {{Item|Golden Fragment|amount=8}}s, allowing the price paid to be increased to {{Coins|500m}} paid. {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |name = [[Midas Staff|{{Fragged}} Midas Staff]] |A1 = Golden Fragment |B1 = Golden Fragment |C1 = Golden Fragment |A2 = Golden Fragment |B2 = Midas Staff |C2 = Golden Fragment |A3 = Golden Fragment |B3 = Golden Fragment |C3 = Golden Fragment |Output = Midas Staff (fragged) }} }} == Essence Crafting == This weapon can be upgraded using Gold Essence. Once converted, it requires {{Skill|Catacombs|25}} to use while in Dungeons. {{Essence Crafting |50|100|150|200|250|convert = 100 |essence = Gold |type = weapon }} == Trivia == * The Molten Wave ability gold blocks do not visually appear on non-full blocks, notably carpets. This is a visual bug however, as it still deals damage as if the wave is rendered. *The Molten Wave ability gold blocks blocks the [[Bonemerang]] projectiles. **It used to block other projectiles, most notably arrows. This makes the Midas Staff less likely to be used in higher floors as archers usually deal much more damage than mages. This was fixed in August 8 2023 Patch Notes. *The Molten Wave ability gold blocks can get stuck within cobwebs.https://www.reddit.com/r/HypixelSkyblock/comments/ou493h/midas_staff_blocks_get_stuck_in_cobwebs/ *The wave cannot hit enemies too close to the player, about 1 block away. *The Greed ability's bonus ability damage used to be bugged, which meant that the bonus ability damage was not boosted by {{Skill|Catacombs}} level in dungeons even if the staff was dungeonized. This was fixed in the 0.14 Bug Fixes 2 Update.https://hypixel.net/threads/yeti-sword-vs-midas-staff-and-f7-questions-solved.4252665/post-30898239 *This item is referred to as "Midas' Staff" in the Dark Auction, however the actual item name is "Midas Staff". *The Midas Staff is also called the "Midas Spoon" or the "Spoon" by the community. **The name "Midas Spoon" possibly stems from the fact that the vanilla Midas Staff texture used to be a golden shovel. *This weapon at {{Coins|100M}} paid has the second highest base magic damage of any weapon after [[Giant's Sword]]. *The ability is used by {{MobSprite|King Midas}} in Dungeons, who was released 3 months prior to this item. == Demonstration == {{YouTube|nUhra2ky8jE|caption=Midas Staff Demonstration}} == Gallery == Midas Staff (in hand).png|In-hand model. The maximum base damage remains 32000 at {{Coins|100M}} paid.}} {{History|2022/August 23|Fixed the bonus ability damage added by the greed ability not being affected by catacombs scaling.}} {{history|2023/June 26|Fixed using '''Midas Staff''' spamming Superboom TNT messages.}} {{history|2023/Aug 8|Fixed blocks from '''Midas Staff''' blocking arrows.}} {{history|2023/Aug 15|Fixed '''Midas Staff''' ability not showing correctly when used above blocks like carpet.|Fixed '''Midas Staff''' ability activating and taking Mana when no blocks are spawned and no damage can be dealt. Now the ability doesn't activate and doesn't take any Mana.}} {{History|0.19.4|Midas Jewel can be applied to the '''Midas Staff'''.}} {{History|0.20.3|'''Midas Staff''' can now be upgraded with [[Golden Fragment]]s.}} {{History|2024/Jul 9|Fixed price paid displayed being capped at {{c|100m}} even if more was paid.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Midas Staff (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Midas Staff''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Swords}} {{Nav/Dark Auction}}
